sql: SELECT ps.set_id, ps.establishment, ps.est_duns, ps.est_operations, ps.site_source, st.fei, st.firm_name, st.country_iso3, st.address FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product_site ps LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.site st ON st.duns = ps.est_duns WHERE ps.set_id IN ('e1dab8ad-cbf6-4273-92fa-02629de2abde', 'ef4e97a7-cd18-47a9-a016-2eca5481a87e') ORDER BY ps.set_id, ps.establishment
